up: Return a list of distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL3880421. For each molecule, provide the ChEMBL ID, the preferred name, and the canonical SMILES string.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880421';
